title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-01-24
lineage: MSR > C > DAT > CD > EAC > mkwACT > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a 1969 Avalon show highlighted by a thunderous New Potato Caboose and a mellow Dark Star, despite a power‑cut ending Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers clear, well‑balanced sound typical of an SBD source, letting the band’s 1969 fire shine through. Reviewers rave about the extended, earth‑shaking Phil Lesh solo on New Potato Caboose and appreciate the unusually mellow Dark Star with its false‑start, while noting a brief power outage that cuts Lovelight short.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and praise the musical performance (especially New Potato Caboose) while noting generally good soundboard quality with only minor mix quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Instruments and vocals are clear and well‑placed; a few reviewers mention the opening mix being a bit harsh, but overall the SBD capture is solid. The power failure at the end of Lovelight is an intentional performance issue, not a recording flaw.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jam‑heavy early set with a false‑start Dark Star, a soaring New Potato Caboose that puts Phil in the ‘Phil Zone’, solid Other One and Dupree's, ending abruptly when management pulls the power during Lovelight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work is praised for amazing jamming after Phil’s lead and overall tone.
band_member_comments.Phil: Thunderous, extended solo on New Potato Caboose; highlighted as one of his best lead moments.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey & Bill keep the groove alive after the power cut, adding energy to the abrupt ending.
